title: Homework: Add a Retry Limit
objective: Write a retry loop that follows the action table, refreshes once after a 401, stops at once on a 403, and gives up after a fixed number of retries.
expected:
request 1: ok after 3 attempts
request 2: stopped: 403 (no retry)
request 3: gave up after 4 attempts
request 4: ok after 2 attempts
